Recorded claim:
The intended shared contract is UI-agnostic `loadCalendarEventSource(identity)` plus `loadCalendarEventSnapshot({ sessionKey, identity })`. Calendar lookup ignores `AbortSignal`, so request-ID matching must reject stale results. [Task 1]
